title: Kate Compton- Polite Programming Languages: Designing a Generative Language without a PL Degree
speaker: Kate Compton
talk_title: Polite Programming Languages: Designing a Generative Language without a PL Degree
description:
This talk is from the 2020 virtual Roguelike Celebration:
https://roguelike.club/event2020.html

Dr Kate Compton (galaxykate) is a long-time generative artist, inventor, and programmer.  She wrote the first paper on procedural platformer levels, generated the planets for Spore, created the language Tracery, and invented an early phone-based AR system. She currently works as an open-source researcher developing the next directions for Tracery and creative chatbots. Her mission is to design artificial intelligence to augment human creativity, and to create tools that brings AI into the hands of poets, artists, kids, and weirdos.

Tracery has been a favorite tool in the Roguelike and generative communities, but it's mostly used for generating text strings.  What if the same principles used to make Tracery were applied to a language for finite state machines? In this talk, Kate describes the common features that her languages share. She also demos an AI agent developed with Nordic ambient musicians as part of their LARP/album, and what it takes to make an agent that can be scripted by musicians and not programmers.

Find her on Twitter: https://twitter.com/galaxykate
Link to Kate's slides: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1JR3i82kJSRT1VsAcKcjJ86OULMTu2QVysixsJ99N1NM/edit
^ Including where you can print your very own Certificate from Dr. Galaxy Kate!
Tracery: http://www.tracery.io/
